comments: Isolation test: dropout alone (no kernel3) on top of plain finetune (0.3684/0.3228), to determine whether kernel3+finetune+dropout's 0.3757/0.3635 win came from dropout or from the kernel3+dropout combination specifically -- this ingredient was never tested in isolation before. Default bottleneck_kernel_size=5 (unchanged from the original architecture), so this loads directly from the original native checkpoint via --finetune with zero shape mismatches (dropout adds no parameters) -- no partial-transfer script needed.
